title: Contact Support: Credits, Billing and Results | AIVideosUGC
description: Questions about credits (the units on your plan), a failed photo or video, billing, or your account? Email support@aivideosugc.com for a written answer.
lead: Need help with a photo, a video, an actor, captions, publishing, your credits, or your account? A credit is one unit your plan spends on a file. Email support@aivideosugc.com and we will help you sort it out.
intro: Contact AIVideosUGC by email at support@aivideosugc.com. Write if you need help with a photo, a video, an actor, or captions. You can also write about a post to TikTok or Instagram, the API, your credits, or your account. The API is how your own software connects to this tool. Include the details below so we can answer without asking you to write again. You also keep a written record of the question and the answer.
Include the email address on your account, and a short note about what happened. If it is about one photo or video, add about when you made it. A screenshot of any error message helps too.

faq.q: How do I reach AIVideosUGC customer service?
faq.a: Email support@aivideosugc.com. That is the way to reach us, and it gives you a written record of the question and the answer.

faq.q: Can you help before I choose a plan?
faq.a: Yes. If you are not sure the tools suit what you sell, email a short note about the products and where you advertise. We will point you to a starting place, such as [AI image to video](page:image-to-video).

faq.q: How long does a reply take?
faq.a: We do not post a reply time. Email support@aivideosugc.com with the account email, what happened, and when you made the photo or video. Then the first reply can cover it.

faq.q: What details help support find my photo or video?
faq.a: The email on your account, what happened, about when it happened, and a screenshot of any error.

faq.q: What if a failed photo or video did not return credits?
faq.a: A failed photo or video returns its credits on its own. If you do not see them, email support with the time you made it and we will check.

faq.q: Do I contact AIVideosUGC by email only?
faq.a: Yes. Email support@aivideosugc.com from the address on your account. We do not offer phone support.

faq.q: Can you help me publish to TikTok or Facebook?
faq.a: Yes. If a send to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook did not go through, email the account address, what you tried, and about when it happened.

faq.q: Who do I email about an actor, captions, or my own software?
faq.a: Email support@aivideosugc.com. Include the account email and what you were trying to do. For example, reusing a presenter (a saved on-screen person), editing captions, or starting work from your own software.
